summary: Rendered fixture and static review found two accessibility issues in vendored UI. Browser checks used a simulated content fragment, not the full companion server. FR-001 requires verbatim vendoring, so fixes need an upstream update or an approved scope change.

findings.summary: Documented choice cards cannot be selected using the keyboard.
findings.evidence: In a rendered 320px fixture, both options had tabIndex -1; Tab did not focus either.
findings.fix: Obtain an upstream fix, then refresh the vendored skill and source pin.

findings.summary: Secondary text and connection status lack sufficient contrast.
findings.evidence: #86868b renders at 3.62:1 on white; #34c759 on white at 2.22:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1.
findings.fix: Obtain upstream theme colors meeting contrast requirements, then refresh the vendored skill and source pin.
